name: Ecology and Evolutionary Biology PhD
summary: PhD research spans evolution, genomics, ecology, behavior, conservation and infectious disease. Applicants apply to the department as a whole and select an adviser from its faculty.

timeline.decisions: Admission decisions are emailed from the end of January through March 15. Waitlisted applicants may receive a final decision closer to April 15.

english.note: TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo is required if your primary language is not English, unless your undergraduate instruction was entirely in English, with the degree awarded before anticipated enrollment, or you completed at least two full-time academic years of graduate study entirely in English. The institution must certify English instruction; the graduate-study exemption must be met when the application opens. The Graduate School has no minimum score.

applicationFee.note: The Graduate School lists waivers for financial hardship, participation in specified programs, recruiting events and virtual workshops, but the pages reviewed do not explicitly confirm international applicants' eligibility. Request a waiver at least two business days before the program deadline; decisions take 2–3 business days.

documents: Academic statement of purpose (in English, maximum 1,000 words)
Unofficial transcripts, including the transcript key, from each current or previous institution; official English translations for records in other languages
requirements.note: Contacting potential faculty advisers early is suggested, but not required. It is the norm for applicants to have at least one faculty member willing to support their application. The Biology GRE Subject Test is optional.

funding.note: Princeton provides all PhD students full tuition, student health plan coverage and a base stipend throughout regular enrollment. Funding is contingent on satisfactory academic performance. No Fall 2027 stipend amount was confirmed.

international.note: The program pages reviewed do not explicitly state international applicant eligibility. The Graduate School currently states that it cannot process applications from individuals located in, or ordinarily resident in, Iran; check its eligibility page for updates.
